title: Native Ringed Restriction Hom
statement: Let F:C→D be a continuous equivalence of sites such that every induced slice functor is an equivalence, and let R be a commutative ring sheaf. Direct module restriction is additive and agrees with the structural ringed pushforward by an identity change-of-scalars isomorphism. For every two cochain complexes L,M, restriction of their sheaf Hom complex is isomorphic to the sheaf Hom complex of their restrictions. The coefficient universe contains both site object and morphism universes; no equality of these universes is assumed. Dependencies: [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], [def-weil-pbc-chain-complex-tensor-module], [def-kun-constant-sheaf], [def-pur-hom-complex].

proof.text: Restriction along a site equivalence commutes with the sheaf Hom complex. Full faithfulness of the induced slice restrictions identifies the sheaves of module homomorphisms. Products of these comparisons give an isomorphism in each degree. Naturality with respect to precomposition and postcomposition identifies the two terms of the Hom differential, so these degreewise isomorphisms form a cochain isomorphism. All products have indices in the fixed coefficient universe; no site or coefficient universe is identified. Source: Stacks 03A0, 03CH, 03DA, 03DG, 08J7 and 0A95.

theorem homComplexRestriction
    {C : Type c} {D : Type d} [Category.{vc} C] [Category.{vd} D]
    {K : GrothendieckTopology C} {J : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (F : C ⥤ D) [Functor.IsContinuous F K J] (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c d vc vd r})
    (hF : ∀ X : C, (Over.post (X := X) F).IsEquivalence) :
    let T := restrictModules.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R
    let S := restrictedCommRing.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R
    let Tc := T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    ∀ L M : CochainComplex (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, d, vd} R) ℤ,
      Nonempty (Tc.obj (homComplex (R := R) L M) ≅
        homComplex (R := S) (Tc.obj L) (Tc.obj M))
